speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned presenting with gait and limb ataxia alongside a significant medical history; could you please describe your specific symptoms and any known past diagnoses in detail?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description. The "drunk-like" walking suggests cerebellar involvement, and the right-sided clumsiness localizes the issue to your left hemisphere. Given your significant medical history, have you ever been diagnosed with multiple sclerosis, a history of head trauma, or any recent infections?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab use for Crohn's disease.

REQUEST IMAGES: Brain MRI with and without contrast.
